items.summary: Recommendation: retain private launch gates and continue bounded read-only evidence capture. Fleet-doctor and operations sweeps are unavailable; access, secrets, isolation, release, dependency, monitoring, incident, and disclosure controls remain unknown. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for security-sensitive public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. TLS evidence shows only that no certificates expire within 30 days. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not proof of compromise. Exact decision: retain private launch gates, continue bounded read-only security evidence capture, and permit only reversible growth adding no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Do not create new security-sensitive production work, requeue, deploy, change permissions or credentials, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach.
